verdict.rationale: Square's docs show a clear payments API with quickstart-style copy-paste code (square-gh-1/2/3 SDK snippets), sandbox testing, idempotency guidance, and multiple payment method guides (card, ACH, Afterpay, Cash App) that together support a fast integration path. However, the evidence pack only demonstrates code samples in Node.js/JavaScript, not multiple languages, and there is no independent developer report confirming a sub-day integration time — only a stale community comment about a feature gap (subscriptions), which is otherwise addressed in docs-23. Missing for 10: multi-language copy-paste examples (Python, Java, PHP, Ruby, etc.), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the 'under a day' integration claim.
